value.description: The controlled value of the meter.

default-value.description:
The initial value of the meter when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the meter.

min.description: The minimum allowed value of the meter.

max.description: The maximum allowed value of the meter.

low.description:
The upper numeric bound of the low end of the measured range.
Defaults to `min`.

high.description:
The lower numeric bound of the high end of the measured range.
Defaults to `max`.

optimum.description:
The optimal numeric value. Combined with `low` and `high`, this decides
which region is preferred (HTML `<meter>` algorithm).
Defaults to the midpoint of `min` and `max`.

locale.description: The locale to use for formatting the value.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

ids.description:
The ids of the elements in the meter. Useful when the label lives outside
the machine and you need to control `aria-labelledby`.

formatOptions.description: The options to use for formatting the value.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
